verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your love is, Your love is
Your love is strong
Your love is, Your love is
Your love is strong

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Our Father in Heaven
Hallowed be Thy name
Above all names
Thy kingdom come
Thy will be done
Give us today our daily bread
Forgive us weary sinners
Keep us far from our vices
And deliver us from these prisons
